title: Truth Wrapped In Blankets of Kindness: A #poetryport gift for everyone who pours energy into #femedtech
summary: Seek voices of those who sow Quilts of truth as our metaphors of meaning, reasons for beings, Flax age rises truth spun on spindles of fallen swords Looms of labor lost as knots of cottage industry take root in villages of our minds. Knowledge is not capital . To be brokered or sold. Knowledge is a kindness blanket warming us all. Also on IndieWeb Poetry Als
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Seek voices
of those who
sow Quilts
of truth
as our metaphors
of meaning,
reasons for beings,

Flax age rises

truth spun on
spindles of fallen
swords


Looms of labor lost


as knots of cottage
industry take
root in villages
of our
minds.

Knowledge is not
capital. To be brokered
or sold.
Knowledge is a kindness
blanket warming
us all.
